title: Red Dead Redemption

inputs.label: Phrase
inputs.how: Pause, open Options, then Cheats. Press Triangle or Y, type the phrase exactly, then switch the cheat on in the list.

warning: Cheats block achievements and trophies, and saves made with cheats on are marked as cheat saves.

codes.phrase: He gives strength to the weak
I don't understand Imnfinity

cheats.note: The misspelling is part of the phrase.

codes.phrase: Abundance is everywhere

cheats.effect: Double-barrel shotgun, Springfield rifle and Volcanic pistol

codes.phrase: It's my constitutional right

cheats.effect: Buffalo rifle, fire bottles, sawed-off, Schofield, semi-auto pistol and Winchester

The root of all evil, we thank you!
